title: This Roller Coaster Hits 149 Miles an Hour in 4.9 Seconds

scenes.text: This roller coaster hits 149 miles an hour in under five seconds.
It's Formula Rossa at Ferrari World, in Abu Dhabi.
A hydraulic launch fires the cars down the track.
Riders feel up to 4.8 times gravity.
Goggles are required, to protect your eyes from airborne dust.

description:
This roller coaster hits 149 miles an hour in under five seconds.
Formula Rossa at Ferrari World Abu Dhabi holds the Guinness record for the highest launch speed, 240 km/h in 4.9 seconds.
Would you ride it?
first_comment: Bonus: the track is 2.2 km long and inspired by the Monza circuit. Would you ride it?
